newsitem.title: CANADA: Corriente up on Argentina drilling hopes.
newsitem.headline: Corriente up on Argentina drilling hopes.

text.p: Trading in Corriente Resources Inc was busy again on Monday as investors pushed the shares up on optimism of drilling results scheduled to be released after market close today, a company spokesman said.
Corriente jumped C$1.65 to C$9.85 in trading of more than 258,000 shares on Monday morning.
The stock has been popular since a gold stock newsletter last week highlighted the company and its joint venuture copper prospect in Argentina, the company said.
The Tacataca project is 60 percent controlled by Australia's Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd and 40 percent by Vancouver-based Corriente.
The project is still in the early stages of exploration, Corriente said.
